question: To which of the state does Sattriya classical dance belong?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sattriya** is one of the **eight classical dance** forms of India.
 
• This dance form originated in the state of **Assam**.
 
• Sattriya dance was introduced by the Vaishnav saint and reformer **Sankaradeva** in the 15th century.
 
• The dance form is a representation of the mythological narratives and teachings of Vaishnavism.
 
• It was traditionally performed in **Sattras (monasteries) **as a part of religious rituals and to convey spiritual messages.
 
• Sattriya has been recognized as a classical dance by the **Sangeet Natak Akademi in 2000**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The dance form is characterized by expressive hand gestures, rhythmic footwork, and intricate body movements.
 
• The traditional attire for Sattriya dance includes a costume made of silk, adorned with traditional Assamese jewelry.
 
• The musical accompaniment for Sattriya includes instruments like the khol (a type of drum), taals (cymbals), and flute.
 
• Today, Sattriya dance has moved beyond the Sattras and is performed on various cultural platforms across India and the world.
